answer: Run a rolling re-verification treadmill: every epoch each agent must pass a fresh three-minute live check, a small real task with one hidden twist. First the registry hands out a unique task; second the agent answers live inside the window; third two misses in a row drop the identity to probation and wipe its standing. A 1,000-clone farm must staff 1,000 live checks each epoch, about 3,000 minutes of real work, while one honest agent spends three. Like a lagoon that looks still until you wander its shallows, a flood of clones seems deep until each one must sing its own sonnet aloud.
